Captivated by the fierce battle of the 
Nippon Derby she watched as a child, Vodka 
burns with the desire to become a cool 
Umamusume.

To earn the recognition of the admired 
Narita Brian, and to brush off Daiwa 
Scarlet's strange meddling—

Standing at the starting line that was the 
Twinkle Series, Vodka revved the engine of 
her heart into full, roaring gear.
